Rationale: The Candidate's logic is a complete reversal of the Ground Truth LISP. The LISP defines a query to find an 'Issue' entity where the 'Cancellation_date' is '2010-09-17' (effectively answering 'What was cancelled on 2010-09-17?'). In contrast, the Candidate attempts to find an 'Event' that occurred on '2010-09-17' and return its 'cancellation_date' attribute (answering 'When was the event of 2010-09-17 cancelled?'). This results in both the wrong target (an attribute instead of an entity) and the wrong relation used for the filter ('date' instead of 'Cancellation_date').
